title: ACIS reachable-index vector slot accounting fast slice
mode: local implementation and generated in-memory regression
scope: Charge ordered reachable-node output slots separately from discovered membership-set nodes
Preserve source traversal order, graph-link output, cycle reporting, and exact fail-closed limits

changes.summary: Added one output-item charge before projection.reachableNodeIndices.push_back for each newly discovered source node.
Updated the generated body/two-lump cycle cap to 36 exact and 35 one-under; exact projection matches default reachable order and graph links and reports the same single cycle.

evidence.redGreen: The one-under refusal assertion failed before the new charge because the previous implementation admitted 35; it passed after accounting the vector slots.

limitations.reasonUncommitted: The shared worktree contains broad pre-existing modifications, including extensive changes to the same source and test files; staging or committing them together is unsafe.
